title: RedotPay taps Ripple to roll out Nigerian naira crypto cashouts
summary: RedotPay said users can convert cryptocurrency into Nigerian naira and receive funds directly in their local bank accounts within minutes.

title: Bitcoin valuation metric projects 96% chance of BTC price recovery in 2026
summary: A similar setup in 2023 preceded a 340% Bitcoin rally, reinforcing the argument that BTC is undervalued at current prices.

title: Bitcoin to end four-year cycle, break out to new highs in 2026: Grayscale
summary: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s 2025 sell-off looks like a local bottom, not a new cycle peak, with Fed policy and US crypto bills key for 2026.

title: Digital asset treasury boom stalls as flows drop to $1.3B and stocks tumble
summary: Bitcoin treasury companies drove November inflows with $1.06 billion, as Ether saw $37 million in outflows despite continued accumulation by BitMine.

title: Bitcoin battles $50K price target as Fed adds $13.5B overnight liquidity
summary: Bitcoin liquidity cues received a clear signal from the Fed, as the end of QT sparked the second-largest overnight liquidity injection since the COVID-19 era.

title: Poland’s president vetoes strict crypto bill in clash with government
summary: Poland’s president vetoed a sweeping cryptocurrency bill over concerns it would stifle innovation and threaten freedoms, sparking a fierce political clash.

title: X402 ecosystem expands as Solana becomes number-one network for payments
summary: Solana has quietly become the busiest chain for x402 payments, clocking an all-time high $380,000 in daily volume and a 750% weekly jump.

title: Ripple, major VCs back RWA platform OpenEden to scale tokenized Treasurys
summary: OpenEden has raised an undisclosed round backed by Ripple and major institutions to expand tokenized US Treasurys.

title: FDIC acting chair says framework for stablecoin laws coming this month
summary: FDIC acting chair Travis Hill will inform the House Financial Services Committee that the regulator plans to propose how it will apply the GENIUS Act this month.

title: Bitcoin miner Canaan plans adaptive green-energy mining platform
summary: Canaan has been steadily investing in renewable energy projects, with a gas-to-computing pilot in Canada and a deal to deploy miners at a wind-powered data center in Texas.
